scope: Record the owner's Android camera smoke report and review generic leafy-vegetable identity; no application change or live provider replay by the agent.

user_report.qualitative_result: 結果大致正確，但綠色菜葉型的蔬菜都被標示為菜葉。

actual_vegetable_identity.basis: User-provided annotations; not independently established species identification.

user_report.url: Previously supplied HTTPS scanner URL, confirmed by user; no request trace inspected.
user_report.source_or_result_section: Both vegetable entries were in the upper pending-confirmation section of the recognition results, according to the user.
user_report.claim_strength: Qualitative user-reported smoke only; no measured recognition or nutrition accuracy.

supplied_image.observation: Two visually distinct green vegetable regions are visible at upper left and lower right. Species labels are attributed to the user, not inferred as proven from the image.

code_review.prompt: backend/services/vision_food_service.py:build_food_recognition_prompt explicitly permits conservative leafy-vegetable names when species is uncertain.
code_review.normalization_and_display: No blanket conversion from specific vegetable names to generic leafy names was found in normalize_vision_result or frontend/lib/scanner.ts mappings.
code_review.photo_specific_root_cause: Photo and user-provided labels are now available; the original model response, scores and rejection reasons remain unavailable, so low confidence versus nutrition mismatch is not determined.
code_review.nutrition_search_boundary: Downstream retrieval must not establish photographed species or raise visual confidence.
code_review.pending_item_contract: ScannerPendingFoods renders rejectedDetections. Both the low-confidence and nutrition-miss backend branches skip nutrition totals; frontend totals reduce detections only. This agrees with the user's reported placement but is not a numerical audit of that phone request.
code_review.same_name_items: Backend scan_id:index IDs and pending UI label_index keys allow separate same-name entries; actual phone item IDs and region-to-ID bindings were not obtained.

offline_helper_probe.scope: Direct calls to three eligibility helpers and the FDC query-plan builder; not a route, provider, cache, registry, or full-pipeline test.
offline_helper_probe.finding: High self-rated confidence and structurally valid fields do not exclude an underspecified generic food identity, including the exact user-reported label 炒菜葉. Specific-name controls passing these helpers do not establish local database coverage or nutrient compatibility.
offline_helper_probe.downstream_limits: Web still checks local status, official database health, reviewed registry compatibility, source policy and other validators; helper eligibility is not evidence that nutrition was retrieved or accepted.

not_verified: Phone request traces, exact browser, independently verified deployment identity, or private Tailscale peer access. Use of the prior public HTTPS scanner URL is user-confirmed.

next_bounded_action: Within the existing identity-confirmation workflow, add and regress a shared identity-specificity gate before FDC search, web-derived positive-cache reads and web completion. Include cooking-qualified generic labels such as 炒菜葉 and separate same-name scan items. Preserve original labels/confidence and require a new server-owned revision after any identity confirmation. Keep known specific foods and legitimate synonyms usable; do not force species guesses or enable production flags.
